dedupe_keys.name: ontario landfills approved landfill listing with the historical large landfill sites data

description: Ontario Landfills lists every approved landfill in the Canadian province of Ontario, and its predecessor, the Large Landfill Sites data set, adds capacity details up to 2014. The current listing gives each site's Environmental Compliance Approval number, ministry region and district, operator, site name, address, municipality and whether it is open or closed; the historical file gives design capacity, fill rates, estimated remaining capacity, engineering designs and monitoring requirements for large sites. The producer is the Ontario Ministry of the Environment, Conservation and Parks. Coverage is province-wide at site level; the current file's metadata is current as of April 2022 and the capacity data stop in 2014. Files are CSV and Excel, free on the Ontario data catalogue and the federal open government portal under the Open Government Licence – Ontario. Caveats: the current listing has no size or capacity (the ministry says these may be added), the historical capacity figures are out of date, sites are identified by address, not coordinates, and closed sites remain listed. Simulation uses: a provincial inventory of disposal sites and remaining capacity for waste system capacity planning, and flood or slope-failure exposure of landfills. Related records: the Environment Agency historic landfill data (data-ea-historic-landfill-sites) is the equivalent for England.
